lead.headline: 41 super PACs named for police, veterans and sick kids raised $181.5M; roughly 4% reached real political spending
lead.number: Builder: at most $22.5M (12.5%) to politics, 2017-24; 73% of the itemized ad money paid a phone and caging vendor block, so real political spending is closer to 4%. That six-vendor block is paid only by sympathy-named committees, 24 of 24.
lead.watch_out: The 66.5% peer is big-donor super PACs; small-dollar peers send only 6.5-8.7%. 46% of the dollars are j8's FEC twins, so it isn't a new lead, and the count is a floor (2 Piaro PACs, $18.75M, were dropped).
